payment_account_merchant_country.summary: The merchant country used to decide which payment solutions are offered.
payment_account_merchant_country.usage: Your business's country. Payment providers such as PayPal use it to decide which solutions are available. Defaults to the store's general country when left unset.

payment_banktransfer_active.summary: Offer Bank Transfer as a payment option at checkout.
payment_banktransfer_active.usage: When Yes, Bank Transfer is available to customers at checkout.

payment_banktransfer_title.summary: The name shown to shoppers for Bank Transfer.
payment_banktransfer_title.usage: The label customers see for this method at checkout.

payment_banktransfer_instructions.summary: Payment instructions shown for Bank Transfer.
payment_banktransfer_instructions.usage: The instructions displayed to the shopper who chooses Bank Transfer — typically the bank account details to send payment to.

payment_banktransfer_order_status.summary: The status new Bank Transfer orders are set to.
payment_banktransfer_order_status.usage: The order status applied when an order is placed with Bank Transfer.

payment_banktransfer_allowspecific.summary: Whether Bank Transfer is limited to specific countries.
payment_banktransfer_allowspecific.usage: Offer Bank Transfer in all allowed countries, or restrict it to the specific countries chosen below.

payment_banktransfer_specificcountry.summary: The countries Bank Transfer is offered in.
payment_banktransfer_specificcountry.usage: The countries where Bank Transfer is available, used when it is limited to specific countries.

payment_banktransfer_min_order_total.summary: Smallest order total that can use Bank Transfer.
payment_banktransfer_min_order_total.usage: Orders below this total cannot use Bank Transfer.

payment_banktransfer_max_order_total.summary: Largest order total that can use Bank Transfer.
payment_banktransfer_max_order_total.usage: Orders above this total cannot use Bank Transfer.

payment_banktransfer_sort_order.summary: The position of Bank Transfer among payment methods.
payment_banktransfer_sort_order.usage: Controls where Bank Transfer appears in the list of payment options. Lower numbers appear first.
